title: Reference-VM slice declared input set
description: Structure of the operator-authored input declaration for the PLN-0001 reference-VM slice. This schema validates structure only. It does not validate that a declared identity resolves, that a digest matches, or that a repository is reachable; those are composition-time obligations under SYS-057 through SYS-059.

id.description: Immutable schema identifier required by ADR-0003.

version.description: Unsupported versions fail rather than degrade.

source.description: The NeutrinOS source the composition is built from.

revision.description: Full commit object name. A branch or tag is not an identity; both move.

packages.description: The package snapshot. Exactness comes from frozen metadata plus a recorded digest, never from a mirror URL alone.

repositories.description: The complete and finite repository list. Precedence is declaration order. A repository absent here is undeclared, and resolution from it fails closed under SYS-059.

tools.description: Every tool whose behavior can change composition output.

intent.description: The minimal fleet intent this slice requires. It is deliberately smaller than the accepted intent model; only the fields the slice exercises appear.

role.description: A generic qualification fixture, not a workstation or router role. See PLN-0001 non-goals.

layers.description: Composition precedence, lowest first. SYS-044 fixes this as common < role < machine; the order is declared here so a violation is observable rather than implicit.

metadata_revision.description: The repository's own recorded revision, carried so a silently republished metadata set is detectable.

frozen.description: Only repositories that are immutable after publication may be declared. A rolling repository cannot be an exact input, so the schema admits no way to declare one.

identity_kind.description: What the identity field is. A version string alone is a label, not an identity.
